description.narrative: With this investment, FMO will contribute to a project aimed to support decarbonization and climate mitigation measures within the company. The project entails a set of mitigation measures that the company will take, either in-house or with consultants, to reach GHG reduction and costs savings. As FMO-AFW has selected decarbonization as a focus theme, i.e. helping our customers move to (more) climate neutral alternatives for coal, gas and wood fired energy, Yalelo has been nominated to pilot a repayable grant to incentivize this move to mitigation. This project concerns the mitigation measures Yalelo will take in its business to contribute towards reducing its overall impact over the long-term and how it will enable the company to become the model for sustainable growth of protein production in developing markets, which is critical if we are to achieve net-zero emissions by 2050.
